definitions.explanation: Leaving school or work before the scheduled end time, typically with permission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧{早退|そうたい}した。
examples.english: I left early because I wasn't feeling well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早退|そうたい}させて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let me leave early today.

examples.japanese: {早退|そうたい}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{早退|そうたい}させた。
examples.english: My child developed a fever, so I had them leave school early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{早退|そうたい}しても⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ですか。
examples.english: I have things to do in the afternoon, so may I leave early?

notes:
{早退|そうたい} means leaving school or work before the scheduled end time, typically with permission. A compound of {早|そう} (early) + {退|たい} (leave/withdraw).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早退|そうたい}する: to leave early
- {早退|そうたい}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧: early-leave notification form
- {早退|そうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to approve leaving early
- {早退|そうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: reason for leaving early

CONTRAST (ATTENDANCE TERMS):
- ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧: arriving late
- ⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧: absence from work
- ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧: absence from school/meeting
- {早退|そうたい}: leaving early

USAGE:
In both school and workplace settings, {早退|そうたい} usually requires submitting a written form ({早退|そうたい}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧) or getting verbal approval from a teacher or supervisor. Common reasons include illness (⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧) and family emergencies.
